newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-JP Morgan ups Charles Schwab.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-JP Morgan ups Charles Schwab.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Michael Freudenstein said he boosted his rating on Charles Schwab Corp to buy from market perform and raised his earnings estimates for the 1996 and 1997 years.
-- The analyst also set a 12-month target price of $30. The stock was trading at 25, up 5/8 of a point, in mid-morning trading Monday.

-- Freudenstein said he raised his 1996 year estimate to $1.29 per share from $1.25 previously, reflecting the difference between Schwab's reported third quarter results of $0.32 per share and his estimate of $0.28 for the quarter.
-- He said he had boosted his 1997 year estimate to $1.50 from $1.35 previously, which he described as "conservative by necessity, given J.P. Morgan's forecast of a tightening Fed in 1997."
-- The analyst noted he was upgrading Schwab in spite of the fact that, "Wall Street is no doubt littered with the skeletons of equity analysts who upgraded brokerage stocks in the month of October."
